evaluation_feedback.reason: The strict word minimum invites repeated feature statements when only three product facts exist. The assertions catch invention but can all pass for repetitive copy; explicitly assess meaningful supported persuasion and redundancy, as this review does.

Keep a semantic distinction between an invented actual commitment and a conditional opinion recommendation. “I'd ... make that repair a commitment with a date attached” is a proposal, not evidence of an existing promise.
The exact-output control is strong evidence for restraint on this paragraph; it cannot by itself establish restraint on more ambiguous or mixed-quality prose.
